headline.purpose: Page-level <h1> only — 'Sourced leads', a lead's own title on its detail page.

body.purpose: Default paragraph and UI text throughout.

label.purpose: Uppercase small-caps naming a value (stat labels, badges, category headers) — never competes with the value it names.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default state for every .surface card — barely perceptible separation from the page.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Cards and the primary button on hover — depth earned by interaction.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals and popovers floating above a dimmed backdrop.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve used everywhere — a confident, slightly decelerated settle.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Default transition duration — hover states, theme change.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one high-emphasis action per view (e.g. a form's submit). Gradient fill, white text, shadow deepens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(58% 0.16 258), oklch(66% 0.14 220)); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.16 258); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — cancel, secondary controls, delete-from-list actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: oklch(96% 0.006 260); color: oklch(22% 0.02 260); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: oklch(90% 0.008 260); } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.16 258); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hot Lead Badge
components.description: Marks a lead whose price/m² clears the discount threshold — the system's one 'look here first' signal.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge--hot { background: oklch(95% 0.05 35); color: oklch(62% 0.22 35); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field across settings, keyword add, and saved-search modal. Border/outline shift on focus only; :user-invalid keeps first-load forms from flashing red.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 260); border-radius: 0.625rem; background: oklch(98% 0.004 260); color: oklch(22% 0.02 260); font: inherit; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), outline-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(58% 0.16 258); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input:user-invalid { border-color: oklch(58% 0.21 25); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(58% 0.21 25) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Vertical primary navigation. Rest state is muted; hover nudges right 2px; active state gets the tint background and deep-blue text.
components.html: Dashboard / Leads
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; color: oklch(46% 0.02 260); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: oklch(96% 0.006 260); color: oklch(22% 0.02 260); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-link--active { background: oklch(94% 0.03 258); color: oklch(48% 0.17 258); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link__icon { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-lead-card { padding: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; background: oklch(100% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 260); border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lead-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.10); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-lead-card--hot { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(62% 0.22 35) 45%, oklch(90% 0.008 260)); background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(95% 0.05 35) 0%, oklch(100% 0 0) 42%); } .ds-lead-card__header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-lead-card__portal { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(62% 0.015 260); text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-lead-card__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; color: oklch(22% 0.02 260); } .ds-lead-card__stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 260); } .ds-lead-card__stats dt { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(62% 0.015 260); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-lead-card__stats dd { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(22% 0.02 260); } .ds-lead-card__stat--positive { color: oklch(62% 0.16 150) !important; }

narrative.overview:
This is an instrument panel for one operator, not a storefront for a visitor. Every screen exists so its one user can look at a property lead, read its €/m² against the neighborhood baseline, and make a keep/reject/triage call in seconds — repeated over 731 leads and counting. The numbers are the hero: price, €/m², discount percentage, area. Everything else — chrome, motion, decoration — recedes so those numbers are never competing for attention.

The palette stays deliberately quiet: one confident, professional blue as the sole accent, spent sparingly (sidebar mark, links, focus rings, the 'hot lead' gradient's cooler partner), and a small set of named signal colors (hot/success/warning/danger) that map to real evaluation states, never used decoratively. Confirmed rejection: no marketing gloss, no gradients-for-their-own-sake, no illustration or stock imagery — this tool is read by the same person, at the same desk, dozens of times a day, and should feel exactly as calm on visit #500 as on visit #1.
keyCharacteristics: Numbers-first hierarchy: price/€m²/discount always outrank titles and descriptions in visual weight.
One accent color, spent rarely — its rarity is what makes it legible as 'this matters.'
Flat by default; elevation is a hover response, not a resting decoration.
Full light/dark parity — every token pair is tuned independently, not auto-inverted.
Native platform primitives over custom widgets (<dialog>, Popover API, CSS scroll-snap) — less surface area, more consistency with the OS the operator already trusts.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terminal Blue is the only non-semantic color in the system. If a new element needs emphasis and it isn't a signal state (hot/success/warning/danger), it borrows Terminal Blue or it doesn't get color at all — never a new hue.

rules.name: The Independent Dark Mode Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is not filter: invert() or an auto-generated palette. Every token has its own hand-tuned dark-mode value, applied via both prefers-color-scheme and an explicit [data-theme="dark"] override for a future manual toggle.

rules.name: The Numeral Precedence Rule
rules.body: Wherever a label sits beside its value, the label is always smaller, lighter-colored, and uppercase; the value is always full-weight at body size or larger. A label must never out-rank the number it names.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: No element ships with a resting shadow beyond the barely-perceptible default. Depth increases only as a direct response to hover/open state, and drops back at rest.

dos: Do keep Terminal Blue as the only non-semantic accent color — new emphasis needs borrow it, they don't introduce a new hue.
Do tune every dark-mode color independently; never auto-invert or filter: invert().
Do let numbers (price, €/m², discount, area) win the visual hierarchy over titles, descriptions, and chrome on every screen.
Do reach for native platform primitives (<dialog>, Popover API, :user-invalid, CSS scroll-snap) before reaching for a JS library.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion globally — never bypass the system's collapse of all durations to 0.01ms with an inline animation.
donts: Don't add gradients, illustration, or stock imagery for decorative purposes.
Don't give a badge a solid-fill background with white text — every badge uses the tint-background / saturated-text pairing.
Don't let a resting element carry a hover-tier shadow — elevation is earned by hover/open state only.
Don't validate a form field as invalid before the user has interacted with it — use :user-invalid, not :invalid.
Don't invest further visual identity in the "House Flipping Pipeline" name or "HF" mark — it's a placeholder; keep brand expression minimal until a real name is chosen.
